name: Sender Business Role 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether an account owner or account servicer sends the message.

AOWN.name: Account Owner
AOWN.definition: Sender is the owner of the safekeeping account. The sender is disclosing the breakdown of the underlying owners of sender’s holdings with the receiver.

ASER.name: Account Servicer
ASER.definition: Sender is the account servicer of an account owned by the receiver.
